# MyWellnessHub

> MyWellnessHub is a comprehensive online therapy and wellness platform offering expert-led services for child development, autism support, and mental health counseling across India.

MyWellnessHub provides evidence-based therapeutic services including speech therapy, occupational therapy, behavioral therapy, and counseling through its proprietary Tele-BASICS platform. The platform serves families across India with multilingual support (Hindi, English, Telugu, Tamil, Urdu) and combines professional expertise with accessible online delivery.

## Key Topics

- Online Therapy
- Speech Therapy
- Autism Screening & Support
- Behavioral Therapy
- Occupational Therapy
- Special Education
- Tele-BASICS Platform
- Early Intervention
- Child Development
- ADHD Support
- Counseling Services
- Telehealth
- Social Skills Training
- Parent Resources
- Speech-Language Assessment

## Core Therapy Services

- [Expert Therapy & Online Counseling Services](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy): Main therapy services page featuring counseling, speech, and behavioral therapy
- [Online Speech Therapy for Kids](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy/online-speech-therapy-for-kids): Expert-led online speech therapy for kids using Tele-BASICS platform
- [Online Behavioral Therapy for Kids](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy/online-behavioral-therapy-for-kids): Behavioral therapy for kids with ADHD, autism, and emotional challenges
- [Online Occupational Therapy for Kids](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy/online-occupational-therapy): Online occupational therapy for motor skills and sensory processing development
- [Online Special Education for Kids](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy/online-special-education-for-kids): Personalized special education for dyslexia, ADHD, and learning disabilities
- [Online Social Skills Training for Kids](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy/online-social-skills-training-for-kids): Expert-led social skills training for confidence and friendship building

## Counseling & Mental Health

- [Expert Online Counselling for Stress, Anxiety & Relationships](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy/online-counselling): Online counselling for stress, anxiety, relationships with licensed professionals
- [Online Marriage Counselling](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy/marriage-counselling): Professional marriage counselling to resolve conflicts and improve communication
- [Relationship Counselling or Couple's Therapy Guide](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/relationship-counselling.php): Comprehensive guide to relationship counselling and couples therapy services

## Autism & Free Consultations

- [Free Online Autism Consultation](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy/free-online-autism-consultation): Free 30-minute autism consultation with certified specialists via Tele-BASICS
- [Free Speech Therapy Consultation](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/services/therapy/free-speech-therapy-consultation): Free speech therapy consultation for speech disorders and language development
- [Early Autism Screening Tests: A Parent's Guide](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/autism-screening-tests.php): Autism screening tools including BEAS-Toddler and Child Edition assessments

## Assessment & Diagnostic Tools

- [Free Speech Tests for Ages 1-7](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/speech-language-communication-tests.php): Expert-designed speech and language assessment tests for early intervention
- [Revolutionize Speech Therapy with Tele Basics](https://www.mywellnesshub.in/online-speech-therapy-redefined-with-telebasics.php): Guide to Tele-BASICS synchronized whiteboard platform for online therapy
